steps.text: Hello! I am your AI Guide. I will guide you through each step of the experiment. Please follow the instructions carefully and perform the actions as directed. Before we begin, let us familiarize ourselves with the simulation interface. To start, click on the Start Walkthrough.
The simulation walkthrough is now complete. You are now ready to perform the experiment.
steps.audio: /audios/The simulation walkthrough is now complete. You are now ready to perform the experiment.wav

steps.text: Now, you may either click the Auto Connect button to make the circuit connections automatically or connect the circuit manually by following the highlighted terminals. Let's begin with the first connection.
steps.audio: /audios/Now, you may either click the Auto Connect button.wav

steps.text: To measure the Thevenin resistance.
Connect terminal 1 to terminal 7.
Connect terminal 2 to terminal 8.
Continue with the remaining instructed connection pairs.
Case 1 connections are completed. Click on the Check button to verify the connections.
This connection is wrong.
Some connections are wrong.
Autoconnect completed. The digital multimeter is now displaying the Thevenin equivalent resistance value. Now, click on the add button to add the reading to the observation table.
Please set RL using the resistance slider.
steps.audio: /audios/Before resistance set, check & auto connect button click.wav

steps.text: Please make the required connections as per the given instructions.
Connections Verified successfully. The digital multimeter is now displaying the Thevenin resistance value. Now, click on the add button to add the reading to the observation table.
Reading is added to the observation table. Keep all six connections in place for Case 2.
Now measure the Thevenin voltage using the same six circuit connections.
Connect terminal 1 to 7.
Connect terminal 2 to 8.
Connect the voltmeter 3 to 9.
Connect terminal 4 to terminal 10.
Click on the Check button to verify the connections.
steps.audio: /audios/Before clicking the Check button for Case 2 and Case 3 connections.wav

steps.text: Connections Verified successfully. Now switch ON the power supply and set the required voltage value.
The reading is displayed on the voltmeter. Now, click on the add button to add the reading to the observation table.
The Thevenin voltage is added to the observation table and the load resistance slider is now unlocked at zero ohms. Keep all six connections in place for Case 3.
Now measure the load current using the same six circuit connections.
Connect the ammeter terminal 5 to terminal 11.
Connect ammeter terminal 6 to terminal 12.
The Case 3 connections are complete.
Click on the Check button to verify the connections.
steps.audio: /audios/Before clicking the Check button for Case 2 and Case 3 connections.wav

steps.text: The reading is displayed on the ammeter. Now, click on the Add button to add the reading to the observation table.
steps.audio: /audios/Power supply turned ON for the 3rd case.wav

steps.text: The final reading is added to the observation table. Now, click on the Calculate button to theoretically verify the theorem.
The resistance and source values are displayed in the theoretical verification panel. Enter the calculated values in the input field, and click the Verify button to verify the theorem.
Incorrect calculations. The Maximum Power Transfer Theorem could not be verified. Please review your calculations and try again.
Calculations are correct. The Maximum Power Transfer Theorem has been verified successfully. Now, click on the Generate Report button.
The simulation has been reset. You can start again.
Opening the print dialog.
Your report has been generated successfully. Click OK to view your report.
Connections verified successfully. Now turn ON the power supply.
Please remove all current wire connections before proceeding to the next case.
steps.audio: /audios/After 1st and 2nd cases are completed, click autoconnect.wav

steps.text: Please enter the required value, then click the “Verify” button to verify the theorem.

steps.text: Please enter all the values, then click the “Verify” button to verify the theorem.
steps.audio: /audios/Verify button click, more than one value is missing.wav

Autoconnect completed. Now turn ON the power supply.
Reading added successfully. Now, vary the load resistance (RL) by moving the resistance slider to take the next reading and then click the Add button.
